summary: Public Committee Against Torture asked the Central Elections Committee to remove Ben-Gvir's Aug. 30 Damon women's-prison campaign video, alleging unlawful use of state prison resources and harm to prisoners' dignity.
notes: Freshness recheck found no final CEC merits ruling on the Damon video. Earlier 2026 CEC decisions concerning different Ben-Gvir detention-facility campaign videos remain relevant precedent but cannot be transplanted to this incident. Preserve the petition allegations as allegations and do not treat them as an adjudicated finding.

summary: Ben-Gvir approved police officer Raot Rosenberg's promotion after roughly a year of withholding approval and after her administrative petition; earlier reporting said police command had unanimously recommended the promotion and no formal reason for the delay had been given.
notes: Freshness recheck found no merits ruling establishing that the prior delay was unlawful. Preserve Rosenberg's allegation that senior police command unanimously approved the promotion and Ben-Gvir's defense that the minister is not a rubber stamp and would examine the matter professionally. Eventual approval after the delay does not by itself establish misconduct or illegality.
